content:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary failure detected for release v2024.3.12 in eu-canaries — 20% request errors (502/504) since 11:02 UTC. Auto-canary pause applied. :rotating_light:

maria: I'm oncall and I'm seeing the page. jumping in. any recent config/flag changes?

tim-sre: pulling logs now, looks like a tokenizer path is throwing repeated "kv cache length mismatch" in the runtime. grabbing stack traces.

alex: I can confirm client telemetry shows a spike in latency and retries that lines up with the canary window. 2% of prod traffic routed to canaries but error amplification hitting downstream retries.

maria: immediate mitigation plan: 1) flip feature flag for tokenizer_v2 off 2) if that doesn't clear, revert single commit from today (c3f4a9b) 3) keep canary paused and monitor. can someone flip the flag?

cs-lead: notifying CS/Support with a short blurb: "We are investigating a degradation affecting a subset of requests for customers in EU regions. Workaround in progress; we will update in 20m."

alex: quick logs snippet I'm seeing in canary pods (truncated):

```
2024-06-07T11:02:10Z service: tokenizer runtime error: kv cache length mismatch: expected 4096 got 0
goroutine 1423 [running]:
  .../runtime/cache.go:231 +0x3f
2024-06-07T11:02:11Z http: 504 gateway timeout for /v1/generate
```

tim-sre: hypothesis: a change in tokenizer initialization (commit c3f4a9b, small refactor to KV cache bootstrap) is causing zero-length entries under heavy concurrency. I can reproduce with a local canary load. recommend revert.

maria: can you run ld-cli to flip the flag first? less blast radius. command I will run if someone posts the toggle.

alex: running it from my machine now: `ld-toggle --flag tokenizer_v2 --env prod --value false --comment "emergency kill - canary errors"`

deploy-bot: Action acknowledged: LaunchDarkly flag tokenizer_v2 set to false by alex at 11:05 UTC.

maria: monitoring metrics — error rate dropped from 20% to 6% in 90s, but not fully resolved. still seeing some 502s on a portion of hosts.

tim-sre: ok still residual failures. I'll queue the single-commit revert. Steps: `git revert --no-edit c3f4a9b && git push origin HEAD && ./ci/deploy --target canary` — I'll coordinate the rollback pipeline.

alex: can we route traffic to fallback model variant while rollback finishes? fallback-policy is enabled but need to ensure cache invalidation doesn't cause additional heat.

maria: set routing to fallback for canaries only. matthew (not in thread) can you confirm? if not available I'll trigger route change.

incident-bot: On-call handoff reminder: @maria is current oncall for 4h. Please confirm escalation path.

tim-sre: revert pushed, pipeline kicked off (build 4392). logs: `deploy-bot: revert-deploy started for release v2024.3.12-revert-c3f4a9b to eu-canaries`

deploy-bot: Build 4392 succeeded, canary deploy of revert started.

maria: CS update (sent): "We applied a mitigation and are deploying a fix; some customers experienced higher latency and a small number of failed requests. No data loss. We'll follow up with incident summary."

cs-lead: continuing to monitor support queue; flagging customers with high token volumes.

alex: metrics trending down — error rate at 1.2% now, p95 latency back to baseline for most hosts.

tim-sre: canaries stable for 12 minutes. promoting revert to prod? maria: if you approve I'll promote after one more stability window (3 min).

maria: approve promote to prod. requesting a quick runbook note: revert commit c3f4a9b, flip tokenizer_v2 back on only after 24h and after perf regression tests.

deploy-bot: promote started: reverting commit c3f4a9b to production.

deploy-bot: Promote succeeded. Production reverted to pre-c3f4a9b state at 11:28 UTC.

maria: final checks — error rate steady at 0.5%, latency normal. CS notified.

tim-sre: created incident ticket INC-20240607-72, adding initial cause: tokenizer KV cache init bug introduced in commit c3f4a9b. next steps: add stronger unit tests for cache bootstrap, add canary load ramp gating, and add a runtime assert to detect zero-length cache entries.

alex: pushed a small monitoring alert to catch kv-cache-zero events in prod instrumentation.

maria: handing off to next oncall (tim in EU morning). I'll follow up with a short postmortem draft and link here. Great quick collaboration — closing active page.

incident-bot: Pager cleared at 11:45 UTC — incident moved to monitoring state.

maria: TODOs assigned: (1) tim-sre write postmortem draft (2) eng-runtime add unit/integration tests (3) devex update rollout docs to include feature-flag kill flow. I'll create cards and tag owners.

cs-lead: preparing customer-facing summary for tomorrow's update.

alex: thumbs up.

maria: closing thread, will link postmortem when ready. :white_check_mark:
